title: A Lantern for the Letter
author: Odile Dravenmoor
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
